control-implementations.description: Dataflow-Policy runs in a browser session. It keeps no persistent storage and calls no external service.

implemented-requirements.description: The built application is accepted only against the application model digest bound in the system model.

props.name: evidence
props.value: just vv application acceptance against System.applicationModelDigest

implemented-requirements.description: Every file of the Pages artifact is listed with its digest; a file outside the closure fails the build.

props.name: evidence
props.value: just vv artifact closure gate over the built Pages artifact

implemented-requirements.description: A request over 4096 bytes is refused, a response over 16384 bytes is replaced by an error, the guest allocates at most 4097 lines.
capabilitiesEmpty is true, externalServices is none and persistentStorage is none, so the guest has no channel out and keeps nothing.
Each release binary is published with a checksum so a downloaded binary can be compared with the release.

props.name: evidence
props.value: checksum file attached to each release by #20

props.name: threat
props.value: Supply-chain substitution of the CLI binary

implemented-requirements.description: dispatch and its callees are kernel-checked, so the refusal paths for oversize and malformed input are proved, not tested.
An SPDX 3.0.1 document lists the components of each shipped artifact.

props.name: evidence
props.value: just vv spdx gate over the release SBOM

props.name: threat
props.value: Supply-chain substitution of the CLI binary

implemented-requirements.description: The report is written to the page as text, never as markup.

props.name: evidence
props.value: generated text view assigns the response as text content

components.description: Dataflow-Policy runs in a browser session. It keeps no persistent storage and calls no external service.
components.remarks:
Accepted risks:

- Compromised Pages host (tampering): The page cannot defend against its own host. A user who needs more than GitHub Pages can compare a release checksum (#20) or build from the tagged source. Hosting on a different origin is out of scope for v0.1.
- Disowned result (repudiation): The report is advisory and carries no signature. Re-running the same request reproduces the same report, because dispatch is a proved pure function, so a dispute is settled by running the check again.
